title: Codex add project deploy plan
summary: Use Codex to add a manifest-driven deployment plan artifact for projects, with focused docs and tests, without performing any live deploy action.

actions.prompt: Add a small manifest-driven deployment plan path for Cortex project manifests. Prefer extending existing manifest tooling so validated project manifests can render a deterministic generated deployment plan artifact or stdout that covers target hosts, enabled services, routes, secrets references, and operator checkpoints. Keep scope tight: do not modify bootstrap/compose/edge/*, do not perform any live deploy action, do not change .codex/config.toml, and keep the output as planning/documentation only. Add focused docs/tests and run targeted validation/tests afterward.
